Hurricane Season Preparation Checklist

The Atlantic hurricane season runs from June 1 to November 30, with most activity typically between mid-August and mid-October (NOAA). This checklist is designed for Florida families with valuable homes, boats, cars and collections. It is an educational guide, not a guarantee of coverage: every policy has its own terms, and official instructions always come first.
